title: Hold a ground spraying business licence
what: Conduct a ground spraying business only under a ground spraying business licence.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 2004 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not: (a) conduct a ground spraying business; or (b) represent that he or she provides a ground spraying service for fee or reward, unless the person: (c) is authorised under a ground spraying business licence;

reach.condition: if it conducts a ground spraying business
